QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Your Seniors
QuestInfo.0: The senior apprentice is waiting for you at the entrance. Go to the xx Dojo.
QuestInfo.1: The first senior apprentice wants you to meet the other senior apprentices and the master. (The third is at Boulder Gorge Training Ground and the second is at Bamboo Training Ground)
QuestInfo.2: You explored the Gold Dragon Dojo and met the other senior apprentices. They all seem nice.

default.0: Our faction members will be at the training grounds nearby. Be polite and show them the proper respect!
